description: MassGIS 2003 Massachusetts MHD Highway Exit Locations (December 2002) is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors MassGIS (Office : Mass.), Massachusetts. Highway Dept.. This point datalayer represents major highway exit locations for the state of Massachusetts. It was produced by the Massachusetts Highway Department (MHD). Feature attributes include the exit number and the highway route number associated with each exit. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: All maps or other documents produced using data or data products supplied through this agreement should contain a data source credit, prominently disp. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
